description: Erdbeben in Nordrhein-Westfalen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gd.nrw.de. On 42 richly illustrated pages, a general overview of earthquakes and their dynamics is given, where and why they arise and how they are recorded. The second part is dedicated specifically to the earthquakes in North Rhine-Westphalia. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Category: Earthquakes in North Rhine-Westphalia" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Epizentrum, Magnitude, Seismogramme, Folgeschäden, Intensität, opendata. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
